title: Crispy Hot-Pot Lamb Roll Gyros with Tzatziki
originalTitle: Crispy Hot-Pot Lamb Roll Gyros with Tzatziki
ingredients: 1 lb thinly shaved frozen hot-pot lamb shoulder rolls (found at Asian grocers — instant gyro shavings!)
1.5 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp coriander, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp onion powder, 1/2 tsp smoked paprika, salt & black pepper
4 thick Greek pita breads, brushed with olive oil and warmed
1/2 red onion, thinly sliced; 2 Roma tomatoes, wedged; 1/2 cucumber, sliced; crumbled feta & fresh dill
instructions: Spread the shaved hot-pot lamb rolls in a large cast-iron skillet over high heat (no extra oil needed; the lamb fat renders immediately).

Sprinkle the Greek gyro spice blend (oregano, cumin, coriander, garlic, onion, paprika, salt, pepper) over the lamb and sear undisturbed for 3–4 minutes until the edges crisp like vertical-spit shawarma/gyro meat.
Warm the Greek pita breads briefly right on top of the sizzling lamb to soak up the spiced juices.
Slather warm pitas with tzatziki and load with crispy lamb shavings, tomatoes, red onion, cucumber, and feta.
